svg.title: Companion Scan markers 3 and 4, 150 mm, 500 mm apart

g.text: Tags 3 and 4 · cscan-6x6-v1 · black squares 150 mm · centres 500 mm apart
Mount: wall, centre of the black square 1200 mm above the floor.
Family cscan-6x6-v1: 6x6 code, 8x8 cells in all.
Size is the outer edge of the black ring: 150 mm.
Markers 3 (left) and 4 (right): centres 500 mm apart on this one sheet. Do not cut it apart.
Cell 18.75 mm. White margin 18.75 mm: keep it clear.
Print at 100% (actual size), not fit to page.
Mount it flat on a hard surface: a curled sheet moves the corners.
The bar below is 100 mm. If it measures less or more,
the black square is 150 mm x measured / 100 mm.
